items.description: Laptop screen crack repair (complete display assembly)
items.rationale: The portable equipment cover is in force, and a swerve in a car is expressly covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2. A cracked screen is an area of damage under 2.6.3(a). The repair stays below the price of a new unit, so 7.1.10 pays the full necessary repair; the display is the larger part of a combined repair of about EUR 1,350-1,400.

A dented housing at a corner is covered under 2.6.3(b) as part of the same loss on the same unit. Replacing the lower shell with a like-for-like part is a necessary repair cost under 7.1.7/7.1.10 and is the smaller share of the combined total.
Treating a pre-existing surface condition is expressly not a repair cost under 7.1.11, 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a), even when done on the same invoice. t = 0.
The examination cost is covered under 5.2.3 because an insured event under 2.6 is established, capped at EUR 250 incl. VAT. A typical shop diagnostic charge is well below that cap.
